in_scope: Controlled, reusable documentation for a live theatrical tribute production.
Event-specific planning through verified event, venue, schedule, personnel, safety, rights, and release records.
Audience-facing materials that use verified facts and original or cleared assets.
Repeatable production, booking, operating, and closeout workflows.
out_of_scope: Claims of official KISS or Gene Simmons affiliation, endorsement, sponsorship, or rights clearance without evidence.
Promotion of prototype, runtime, draft, historical, or generated material to approved canon.
Unverified dates, venues, offers, capacities, named partners, or personnel assignments as durable facts.
Storage of secrets, raw personal contacts, submissions, or sensitive diagnostics in this public-readable compendium.
Creative or schedule instructions that override safety HOLD, ABORT, or STOP authority.

objective_classes.objective: Deliver a coherent audience-facing theatrical tribute experience using only verified claims and cleared presentation material.
Make approved show intent executable, safe, traceable, and recoverable across departments.
Separate reusable GEN controls from event-specific facts so the production can be advanced and repeated without fact forks.
Support evidence-based venue and booking review without making an unapproved public or commercial promise.

constraints: Controlled DOCX domains and supporting identities remain distinct.
Every managed item is Timeline-specific or GEN.
Privacy minimization and restricted-reference-only handling apply.
Public claims require affiliation, rights, accessibility, and factual verification as applicable.
